text: SaaS founders — how are you doing your demo videos? I keep putting it off because I don't have design/editing skills and hiring feels like overkill for a $0 MRR product lol. What's actually working for you?
comment_source_reason: A question specifically about producing demo videos, answered by founders describing their own DIY process (the app's exact buyer: founders without editing skill or time) and by video editors/agencies/rival tools pitching in the replies (direct competitors).
